verdict.rationale: Modal is a developer platform with SDKs and a CLI, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question, but the pack shows no such reference. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the available evidence (llms.txt, markdown docs, a CLI reference page, an agent skill) covers adjacent documentation features, not an interactive, runnable API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
